sketch.coordinate-check.summary: Compare explicit sketch-local, model, and world coordinates with native sketch geometry and optionally read back a feature-owned BRep.

inputs.sketch: Native sketch reference in the selected component.
inputs.expectations: Nonempty array of {entity, frame?, point?, center?, start?, end?, radius?, diameter?}. Entity is an explicit sketch point/curve reference. Point asserts SketchPoint.geometry; center asserts the analytic curve center; start/end assert defining SketchPoints. Coordinates and dimensions are unit-bearing expressions. frame is sketch(default), model, or world.
inputs.tolerance: Positive length expression for coordinate and dimension comparisons; default 0.001 mm.
inputs.occurrence: Optional explicit occurrence instancing the sketch component; required for root-world checks of a non-root sketch.
inputs.featureBRep: Optional {feature, expectations} containing explicit BRep edge/face/vertex refs. Every entity must belong to one of the named feature's result bodies. BRep expectations use model frame only.

limitations: Read-only snapshot; no solve, recompute, activation, repair, or model mutation.
Sketch/model roundtrip and native worldGeometry are separate evidence. Without an explicit occurrence, only a root-native sketch can be checked in root-world coordinates.
Feature-body membership is not proof of generating-profile provenance.
Unsupported requested native properties return unknown. This offline implementation is not native Fusion qualification.

sketch.profile-query.summary: Query native profile integrals, loop topology, and hole-aware containment; select only one complete, unique profile.

inputs.sketch: Native sketch reference in the selected component.
inputs.query: Optional conjunctive criteria: index (nonnegative integer), area (positive finite cm^2 number), centroid/contains (three length expressions), outerLoops, innerLoops (nonnegative integers).
inputs.expected: Optional exact nonnegative counts for profiles, loops, outerLoops, and innerLoops. Missing topology is unknown, not zero.
inputs.tolerance: Positive length expression for sampled topology and containment; default 0.001 mm.
inputs.areaTolerance: Positive finite number in cm^2 for native integral comparisons; default 0.000001.
inputs.maxSamples: Shared evaluator-stroke cap across sketch curves and profile boundaries; integer 2..10000, default 2000.
inputs.budgetMs: Shared monotonic work budget in milliseconds; integer 1..120000, default 10000.

limitations: Native high-accuracy area/centroid and loop enumeration are separate from sampled connectivity and containment.
Containment uses native profile loops, including holes. Points in the stroke-tolerance band are unknown.
Sampled branches, degeneracies, duplicate strokes, open loops, and intersections fail sampled topology but do not provide a continuous analytic certificate.
No profiles.item(0) fallback: ambiguity, no match, or incomplete topology yields no profile selector.
Offline doubles do not qualify native Fusion or model-kernel behavior.
